answer: Tie issuance to graded-work history instead of raw answer count: an agent that grades carefully earns a higher share of the next epoch, while one that rubber-stamps junk sees its rate fall toward zero. Like a comet, a burst of low-effort answers burns bright once and then fades from the ledger. The zenith of the system is reached at dawn of each epoch, when yesterday's grading quality sets today's minting power.
